skills.elemental_skill: Throws out a Floral Ring that deals instance of Dendro DMG to targets it comes into contact with. The Floral Ring will return after a set time, dealing Dendro DMG once again. When this skill hits at least one enemy, it generates Elemental Particles. The Floral Ring will fly back to the player even if the player moves away from their original position. The period of time in which the Floral Ring stays on-field can be greatly extended if the player can exceed the speed in which the Floral Ring returns to the player. Characters with fast movement speed (e.g., Sayu ) can achieve this easily. However, only two instances of damage can be dealt even if the Floral Ring makes contact with the enemy...
